integrity: The gap theorem is proved for every positive real weighting. Independent terminal/deletion distance enumeration on small instances corroborates but does not prove unrestricted quantifiers. Exact values and all counts follow the in-package combinatorial proof. No external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite simple positively edge-weighted cycles with at least two terminals; edge deletion has unit cardinality cost. It does not classify arbitrary graphs, directed networks, zero/negative lengths or weighted deletion cost. Historical novelty is based on accessible literature and is not independently certified.
title: Complete semi-cutting spectra of positively weighted cycles: a terminal-gap threshold and cyclotomic roots
